wpn_iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
wpn_iron_sword.description: A basic sword made of iron.

arm_ironroot_legplates.name: Ironroot Legplates
arm_ironroot_legplates.description: Plates of iron infused with the root system of an ancient deadwood tree. They flex like wood, hold like iron, and regrow minor damage over time somehow.

arm_rangers_boots.name: Ranger's Boots
arm_rangers_boots.description: Well-made leather boots designed for long travel across rough terrain. Thick soles, good ankle support, quiet on stone.

wpn_serrated_hatchet.name: Serrated Hatchet
wpn_serrated_hatchet.description: A woodcutter's axe with teeth filed into the blade edge. Brutal in close quarters. The notches catch and tear.

wpn_venomcoil_whip.name: Venomcoil Whip
wpn_venomcoil_whip.description: A serpentine whip with venom glands from three different serpents braided into its core. Each crack releases a mist of poison.

arm_ironstudded_leggings.name: Iron-Studded Leggings
arm_ironstudded_leggings.description: Leather leggings reinforced with a grid of iron studs along the thigh and shin. Heavier than soft leather but considerably harder to cut through.

arm_padded_coif.name: Padded Coif
arm_padded_coif.description: Layers of padded cloth stitched into a tight coif. It won't stop iron but it cushions blows. Good enough for the desperate.

arm_plague_bearers_cowl.name: Plague Bearer's Cowl
arm_plague_bearers_cowl.description: A full hood and mask of hardened leather soaked in alchemical compounds. Stinks of sulphur. Keeps toxins out — and keeps secrets in.

wpn_shadowfang_sword.name: Shadowfang Sword
wpn_shadowfang_sword.description: A slender blade that seems to blur in dim light. Strikes from shadow deal extra pain — enemies never see it coming.

arm_voidwalker_slippers.name: Voidwalker Slippers
arm_voidwalker_slippers.description: Crafted from the same formless material as the space between dimensions. You can walk on surfaces that technically can't support weight. Try not to think about the physics.

acc_scratched_iron_ring.name: Scratched Iron Ring
acc_scratched_iron_ring.description: An iron ring worn smooth on the inside from years of use. There was an inscription once. It's been rubbed away.

arm_rough_hide_shoes.name: Rough Hide Shoes
arm_rough_hide_shoes.description: Shoes cut from a single piece of dried hide and laced up the front. Primitive but effective. Your feet will hate you. They'll survive.

arm_ashwalker_halfplate.name: Ashwalker Halfplate
arm_ashwalker_halfplate.description: Half-plate legguards salvaged from the ruins of a burned city. The iron has been cooled and retempered by the collapse — it's stronger for it.

arm_nightcallers_mask.name: Nightcaller's Mask
arm_nightcallers_mask.description: A porcelain mask fused to a shadowsteel backing. The porcelain shows a serene, featureless face. Behind it, the wearer becomes something else entirely.

acc_crown_shard_circlet.name: Crown Shard Circlet
acc_crown_shard_circlet.description: A fragment of a legendary crown reassembled into a headband. The original crown could subjugate kingdoms. This fragment subjugates only the wearer's fear. That's enough.

arm_padded_breeches.name: Padded Breeches
arm_padded_breeches.description: Quilted cloth breeches stuffed with scraps of wool. They cushion falls and moderate impacts. Fashion has not visited them.

acc_the_endless_ring.name: The Endless Ring
acc_the_endless_ring.description: A ring with no visible seam — it looks as though it was simply formed already around a finger that no longer exists. Time inside the ring is slightly stretched. Cooldowns feel shorter.

acc_braided_grass_bracelet.name: Braided Grass Bracelet
acc_braided_grass_bracelet.description: Tightly braided dried grass soaked in resin. Charms woven into the braid by a hedge-witch. Faint magic — the kind that might or might not be real.

con_void_stamina_concentrate.name: Void Stamina Concentrate
con_void_stamina_concentrate.description: A jet-black gel sealed in an obsidian capsule. Stamina is restored beyond its natural maximum temporarily. Fatigue is not merely removed — it is reversed. You feel as though you haven't slept in days and are completely fine about it.

arm_rough_cloth_trousers.name: Rough Cloth Trousers
arm_rough_cloth_trousers.description: Crude trousers cut from burlap. They chafe. They offer almost no protection. But they're better than nothing — the battlefield is no place for bare legs.

con_titans_marrow_broth.name: Titan's Marrow Broth
con_titans_marrow_broth.description: A thick, warm broth rendered from the bones of something enormous. It smells of iron and old earth. One mouthful eliminates fatigue entirely. Two mouthfuls make you feel invincible. There is no third mouthful.

arm_helm_of_the_last_siege.name: Helm of the Last Siege
arm_helm_of_the_last_siege.description: Worn by the commander of the siege that ended the old empire. The iron bears marks from twelve direct strikes — none of which killed him. He died in his sleep, decades later, still wearing it.

arm_leather_cap.name: Leather Cap
arm_leather_cap.description: Boiled leather shaped into a simple cap. Worn by farmers and sentries alike. Cheap to make, cheap to replace.

arm_swamp_walker_boots.name: Swamp Walker Boots
arm_swamp_walker_boots.description: High boots treated with multiple coats of waterproofing compound. Designed to move silently through wet terrain. Used by hunters, trappers, and worse.

arm_padded_gambeson.name: Padded Gambeson
arm_padded_gambeson.description: Thick quilted cloth worn under armour — or, for those who can't afford armour, instead of it. Absorbs blunt force reasonably well.

arm_titans_foundation.name: Titan's Foundation
arm_titans_foundation.description: Sabatons so heavy that carrying them requires exceptional strength. Wearing them, the ground seems to push back with equal force — anchoring you, steadying you, refusing to let you fall.

arm_berserkers_mantle.name: Berserker's Mantle
arm_berserkers_mantle.description: Fur and iron fused into a brutal war-cloak. It offers less coverage than plate but allows total freedom of movement. For those who plan to end fights quickly or die trying.

con_mudblood_tincture.name: Mudblood Tincture
con_mudblood_tincture.description: A foul-smelling brownish liquid drawn from a swamp herb known locally as mudblood root. Clots wounds. Tastes exactly as bad as it smells.

arm_gravewalker_sabatons.name: Gravewalker Sabatons
arm_gravewalker_sabatons.description: Iron sabatons taken from a burial site. The bones of their previous owner were found inside. They haven't been cleaned. Something about them discourages the attempt.

wpn_godsbane_fragment.name: Godsbane Fragment
wpn_godsbane_fragment.description: A shard of what was once a divine weapon, reforged into a war blade by a blacksmith who then went blind. The divine power within it is corrupted, unstable — and devastating.

arm_chainmail_shirt.name: Chainmail Shirt
arm_chainmail_shirt.description: A shirt of interlocked iron rings. Heavy and loud. It catches blades well — but the weight tells on a long march.

arm_fleetfoot_greaves.name: Fleetfoot Greaves
arm_fleetfoot_greaves.description: Enchanted iron greaves that have somehow been made lighter by the enchanting process rather than heavier. The enchanter considered this proof of genius. The enchanter is dead, but not from arrogance.

arm_scavengers_coat.name: Scavenger's Coat
arm_scavengers_coat.description: A long coat patched together from salvaged leathers. Mismatched seams and rough stitching throughout. It's ugly but it covers everything.

acc_ring_of_the_black_sun.name: Ring of the Black Sun
acc_ring_of_the_black_sun.description: A jet-black ring bearing a golden sun etched into the surface — but the sun's rays point inward rather than outward. Wearing it in sunlight produces no shadow.

wpn_iron_shiv.name: Iron Shiv
wpn_iron_shiv.description: A sliver of scrap iron wrapped in cloth at the base to form a crude grip. Short, ugly, and practical.

con_blue_mist_vial.name: Blue Mist Vial
con_blue_mist_vial.description: A squat vial of deep blue mist in liquid form — pressurised mana extracted from a leyline crack. Mana restoration at roughly three times the potency of a common draught.

wpn_bonebreaker_war_maul.name: Bonebreaker War Maul
wpn_bonebreaker_war_maul.description: A colossal iron maul with a head shaped from fused bones. It ignores armour. It ignores mercy.

con_the_last_drop.name: The Last Drop
con_the_last_drop.description: A single vial said to be the last remaining batch of a legendary healer's personal formula, lost for a generation. It was rediscovered in a collapsed cellar. There are five vials. There were never more.

con_eternity_draught.name: Eternity Draught
con_eternity_draught.description: A perfectly clear liquid with no smell and no taste. It doesn't seem to do anything for a moment — and then everything repairs itself at once. Every wound, every depleted reserve, every ache.

arm_shadowwalker_boots.name: Shadowwalker Boots
arm_shadowwalker_boots.description: Leather boots soaked for three months in shadowmoss extract until the leather darkened permanently. They dampen sound to near silence. Ideal for those who prefer not to be heard.

arm_ironmaw_sabatons.name: Ironmaw Sabatons
arm_ironmaw_sabatons.description: Sabatons with serrated lower edges, designed so a stomp does maximum damage. Not subtle. Not elegant. Extremely functional.

arm_wardens_haubergeon.name: Warden's Haubergeon
arm_wardens_haubergeon.description: A full-coverage hauberk of fine chainmail issued to prison wardens. Has seen use on both sides of the bars.

arm_voidstrider_leggings.name: Voidstrider Leggings
arm_voidstrider_leggings.description: Leggings woven from the same material as the space between worlds. Steps through rough terrain feel oddly smooth. Steps through dangerous terrain feel oddly exciting.

arm_godflesh_armour.name: Godflesh Armour
arm_godflesh_armour.description: No one knows which god this armour was flayed from. The iron-grey flesh that forms its surface is warm to the touch and does not decay. It pulses very slightly, like a sleeping heartbeat.

arm_wraithstride.name: Wraithstride
arm_wraithstride.description: Dark-iron sabatons that blur slightly when moving. The wearer leaves no tracks. No footprints in mud, no marks on snow, nothing in ash. Something that useful has a cost — it just hasn't announced itself yet.

arm_wraithstep_greaves.name: Wraithstep Greaves
arm_wraithstep_greaves.description: Greaves that allow the wearer to briefly step through solid matter once per encounter. The sensation is described as cold and deeply wrong.

arm_chainleg_wrappings.name: Chainleg Wrappings
arm_chainleg_wrappings.description: Chainmail wrapped around the legs like leggings and secured with leather cord. Unorthodox but protective where it matters.

acc_knuckle_rings.name: Knuckle Rings
acc_knuckle_rings.description: Four brass rings designed to be worn across all the knuckles of one hand at once. Not subtle. Very direct.

wpn_wooden_club.name: Wooden Club
wpn_wooden_club.description: A gnarled branch ripped from a dead tree and stripped down to a crude bludgeon. No craft. No glory. Just blunt force.

arm_bloodbound_cuirass.name: Bloodbound Cuirass
arm_bloodbound_cuirass.description: Dark iron plates bound together with alchemically treated leather straps. The iron seems to drink light. Wounds heal faster while worn — but the cuirass needs the blood to do it.

arm_nighthide_cuirass.name: Nighthide Cuirass
arm_nighthide_cuirass.description: Crafted from the hide of a creature that exists only in the dark between worlds. It bends shadows. Arrows shot at the wearer seem to arrive a hand's-width to the left.

acc_soulchain_amulet.name: Soulchain Amulet
acc_soulchain_amulet.description: An amulet on a chain of compressed souls — each link is a life. The weight is greater than the physical mass suggests. Whatever powers it, it works.

arm_the_iron_march.name: The Iron March
arm_the_iron_march.description: Sabatons worn by a conquering army's vanguard for forty years without rest. The iron absorbed so many miles it has become something more. The wearer never tires of walking — and walking never tires of them.

arm_godgrave_sabatons.name: Godgrave Sabatons
arm_godgrave_sabatons.description: Torn from the feet of a god who fell at the edge of the known world. Still warm. Still faintly divine. The soles never wear down.

arm_scrap_leather_pants.name: Scrap Leather Pants
arm_scrap_leather_pants.description: A patchwork of leather scraps stitched together roughly. The work is poor but the coverage is complete.

arm_marching_sabatons.name: Marching Sabatons
arm_marching_sabatons.description: Half-plate sabatons used by infantry. Articulated across the toes, solid on the heel and instep. A little heavy for running. Good for standing your ground.

con_iron_will_tonic.name: Iron Will Tonic
con_iron_will_tonic.description: A bitter black liquid made from ironbark resin and endurance herbs fermented for forty days. Floods the body with stamina. Tastes of bark and poor decisions.

arm_dreadwalker_legplates.name: Dreadwalker Legplates
arm_dreadwalker_legplates.description: Heavy iron legplates engraved with sigils of dread that radiate fear in a radius around the wearer. Enemies hesitate. Sometimes that's enough.

wpn_voidedge.name: Voidedge
wpn_voidedge.description: A blade that opens a small rift in reality with each swing. What lives in that rift is unknown. What comes out of the wounds is best not examined.

arm_marauders_coat.name: Marauder's Coat
arm_marauders_coat.description: A long coat of waxed leather studded along the shoulders and chest. Worn by raiders who travel light and fight hard.

arm_riveted_leather_cuirass.name: Riveted Leather Cuirass
arm_riveted_leather_cuirass.description: Thick leather reinforced with iron rivets across the chest and shoulders. Heavier than it looks. Stops most slashing blows.

arm_executioners_tassets.name: Executioner's Tassets
arm_executioners_tassets.description: Heavy iron tassets hanging from a thick leather belt. They protect the hips and upper thighs. They were made for a much larger man — someone adapted them.

arm_scavenged_skullcap.name: Scavenged Skullcap
arm_scavenged_skullcap.description: A scrap of hammered iron bent into a rough skullcap. Unfinished edges, no padding, no lining. Uncomfortable — but solid enough.

wpn_soldiers_spear.name: Soldier's Spear
wpn_soldiers_spear.description: A dead soldier's spear, still serviceable. The shaft has been re-wrapped in leather where it cracked. Reach is its only virtue.

con_hardtack_biscuit.name: Hardtack Biscuit
con_hardtack_biscuit.description: A square of dried flour and salt baked until indestructible. It lasts forever and tastes like it. Restores endurance, if not morale.

acc_runeband_of_endurance.name: Runeband of Endurance
acc_runeband_of_endurance.description: A wide iron band engraved with endurance runes in concentric circles. The carvings go all the way to the inner surface. The wearer's stamina regenerates faster.

arm_nightstrider_leggings.name: Nightstrider Leggings
arm_nightstrider_leggings.description: Dark leather leggings treated with shadowmoss oil that muffles footsteps. Designed for infiltration. The silence they provide is worth more than the armour rating.

arm_the_faceless_helm.name: The Faceless Helm
arm_the_faceless_helm.description: A helm with no eye slits, no visor, no seam — yet the wearer sees perfectly. No one has ever explained how. No one who wore it long enough cared to.

arm_scavenged_work_boots.name: Scavenged Work Boots
arm_scavenged_work_boots.description: Heavy leather boots nailed together from mismatched pieces. The left and right don't quite match. The sole of one is thicker than the other. You adapt.

arm_brigands_harness.name: Brigand's Harness
arm_brigands_harness.description: A leather harness worn by road thugs. Straps crisscross the torso, holding pouches, spare blades, and a reasonable amount of protection.

acc_copper_band.name: Copper Band
acc_copper_band.description: A plain copper ring, slightly green at the edges. Mass-produced. No magic. No mystery. But everyone needs a ring to start somewhere.

wpn_gravediggers_pickaxe.name: Gravedigger's Pickaxe
wpn_gravediggers_pickaxe.description: Once used to split earth. Now used on things that breathe. The iron head is stained darker than dirt.

acc_thornfinger_ring.name: Thornfinger Ring
acc_thornfinger_ring.description: A gold ring with a black thorn as its setting, extracted from a cursed briar that grew over an old battlefield. The thorn never dulls and occasionally draws blood on its own.

con_soldiers_field_dressing.name: Soldier's Field Dressing
con_soldiers_field_dressing.description: A treated bandage soaked in alchemical coagulant, rolled tight in a wax-sealed tube. Military issue. Apply to wound and wait. Works faster than prayer.

arm_wraithforged_plate.name: Wraithforged Plate
arm_wraithforged_plate.description: Hammered from metal reclaimed from a wraith's physical anchor. It cannot be penetrated by enchanted blades — they pass through as though hitting fog. Physical strikes, however, land normally.

arm_ironcapped_boots.name: Iron-Capped Boots
arm_ironcapped_boots.description: Standard boots with iron toecaps bolted on. They hurt to kick with. They hurt more to be kicked by.

arm_corpsewarden_armour.name: Corpsewarden Armour
arm_corpsewarden_armour.description: Iron armour forged for those tasked with guarding plague burial sites. The iron has been treated to resist corruption. Something of the plague still clings to it regardless.

con_godblood_vial.name: Godblood Vial
con_godblood_vial.description: A vial of dark red liquid with a golden sheen that settles at the top. Obtained from a wound in something much larger than a man. Heals nearly everything. The source is not a safe place to return to.

wpn_bone_knife.name: Bone Knife
wpn_bone_knife.description: Carved from the leg bone of some large beast. The edge was filed sharp by someone patient and bored. Still serviceable.

wpn_dreadfall.name: Dreadfall
wpn_dreadfall.description: A blade that fell from the sky wrapped in dark lightning during the Cataclysm. No one remembers who forged it. The runes on the grip shift when no one is watching.

arm_travellers_leggings.name: Traveller's Leggings
arm_travellers_leggings.description: Well-worn leather leggings made for long roads. Patched at the knees and inner thigh. Practical and unremarkable.

arm_hemp_work_shirt.name: Hemp Work Shirt
arm_hemp_work_shirt.description: A reinforced hemp work shirt soaked in diluted tar for a touch of protection. Not armour. Barely a deterrent.

arm_rough_cloth_tunic.name: Rough Cloth Tunic
arm_rough_cloth_tunic.description: Coarse fabric stitched into a barely-functional garment. One tear away from falling apart — but it keeps the cold off.

wpn_rusty_dagger.name: Rusty Dagger
wpn_rusty_dagger.description: A short blade eaten by rust and neglect. The edge chips more than it cuts, but it's better than bare fists — barely.

arm_shadowmask.name: Shadowmask
arm_shadowmask.description: A sleek iron mask polished to a mirror finish, then painted over in flat black. The face inside it is impossible to read.

wpn_the_last_rites.name: The Last Rites
wpn_the_last_rites.description: A ceremonial executioner's blade repurposed for war. Its edge has never needed sharpening. Legends say it knows when death is due.

arm_ironblight_helm.name: Ironblight Helm
arm_ironblight_helm.description: The iron has been exposed to blight energy for so long it has darkened and grown faintly luminescent. Blight-touched creatures flinch from it.

con_essence_of_the_first_mage.name: Essence of the First Mage
con_essence_of_the_first_mage.description: Crystallised mana residue from the first mage who ever lived, dissolved into drinkable form by someone who really shouldn't have. The mana restoration is complete and instantaneous. So is the migraine.

wpn_wraithblade.name: Wraithblade
wpn_wraithblade.description: A translucent blade forged from solidified shadow essence. It phases through armour on precise strikes, and the wound doesn't bleed — it drains.

wpn_runecarved_axe.name: Runecarved Axe
wpn_runecarved_axe.description: An axe with crude runes gouged into the flat of the blade. The runes glow faintly in the dark. The magic is unstable but real.

arm_doomplate.name: Doomplate
arm_doomplate.description: A massive black iron breastplate etched with scenes of slaughter. It amplifies aggression — most who wear it long enough stop wanting to take it off.

arm_last_march_legplates.name: Last March Legplates
arm_last_march_legplates.description: Worn by a general who marched her army one thousand miles without stopping. The iron remembers the distance. The wearer's legs never tire.

arm_soldiers_helm.name: Soldier's Helm
arm_soldiers_helm.description: Standard infantry helmet. Dented, scratched, and beaten. The previous owner didn't survive to reclaim it.

arm_crown_of_the_damned.name: Crown of the Damned
arm_crown_of_the_damned.description: A jagged iron crown stained black with old blood. It carries the memories of every king who wore it — and every king who wore it died badly.

wpn_ashenwhisper.name: Ashenwhisper
wpn_ashenwhisper.description: A slender sword that seems to burn cold rather than hot. Touch it bare-handed and your fingers go numb for hours. Its kill count is carved into the crossguard in marks too small to count.

acc_silver_chain_bracelet.name: Silver Chain Bracelet
acc_silver_chain_bracelet.description: A simple silver chain worn at the wrist. The links are silver-soldered, not cast. Someone took time with this. A faint ward lingers.

wpn_bloodreaper_scythe.name: Bloodreaper Scythe
wpn_bloodreaper_scythe.description: A massive curved blade mounted on a bone-inlaid shaft. Each kill sends a pulse of heat up through the handle, like the weapon is feeding.

arm_ironplated_vest.name: Iron-Plated Vest
arm_ironplated_vest.description: A leather vest with rectangular iron plates sewn into the front. Covers the vitals. The back is bare — mind your flanks.

acc_pebble_pendant.name: Pebble Pendant
acc_pebble_pendant.description: A smooth stone on a leather cord. It is cold to the touch regardless of temperature. That's probably not a good sign, but nothing bad has happened yet.

arm_thornweave_helm.name: Thornweave Helm
arm_thornweave_helm.description: A helm wrapped in iron thorns pressed from the outside in. The thorns bite headbutters. The padding inside is surprisingly soft.

arm_padded_foot_wraps.name: Padded Foot Wraps
arm_padded_foot_wraps.description: Thick cloth wound around the feet and secured with leather strips. What soldiers wear when boots aren't available. Which is often.

acc_grave_iron_knuckle_ring.name: Grave Iron Knuckle Ring
acc_grave_iron_knuckle_ring.description: A single massive ring designed to cover three fingers. Forged from iron taken from a mass grave. The dead who supplied the ore have opinions about who wears it. They communicate through dreams.

arm_brigands_kickers.name: Brigand's Kickers
arm_brigands_kickers.description: Reinforced boots favoured by road brigands. Steel insole. Weighted heel. Designed equally for walking and for stomping things that are already down.

arm_hexcloth_robe.name: Hexcloth Robe
arm_hexcloth_robe.description: Thick robes woven with hex-thread that wards off minor enchantments. Favoured by those who fight mages — or are afraid of them.

arm_gravewarden_helm.name: Gravewarden Helm
arm_gravewarden_helm.description: Shaped like a grimacing iron skull with hollow black eye slots. Burial wards are carved along the crown. Those who wear it claim they no longer dream.

arm_veilcrown.name: Veilcrown
arm_veilcrown.description: A crown forged from shadow-iron that bends light around the wearer's head in dim conditions. Royalty wore it. Their graves are unmarked.

arm_chainmail_coif.name: Chainmail Coif
arm_chainmail_coif.description: A coif of interlocked iron rings that drapes over the head and neck. Heavy. Hot. But no blade slides through easily.

arm_dreadstrider_sabatons.name: Dreadstrider Sabatons
arm_dreadstrider_sabatons.description: Massive black iron sabatons carved with marching runes. Each step shakes the ground slightly. The sound announces your arrival. Some find this advantageous.

arm_scarred_ironplate.name: Scarred Ironplate
arm_scarred_ironplate.description: A full iron breastplate deeply scored by weapons that failed to penetrate it. Each scar is its own story. The plate is still sound.

arm_hexed_iron_masque.name: Hexed Iron Masque
arm_hexed_iron_masque.description: An iron masque etched with hexing sigils. Whoever put the hex on it is long dead. The sigils still pulse on moonless nights.

arm_crucible_sabatons.name: Crucible Sabatons
arm_crucible_sabatons.description: Forged in a volcano's crucible from ore that hadn't solidified yet. The resulting iron is denser and stranger than anything smelted conventionally. The surface shimmers with trapped heat.

arm_ironblight_lamellar.name: Ironblight Lamellar
arm_ironblight_lamellar.description: Lamellar plates made from blight-forged iron. They faintly hum in the presence of the undead — which is either reassuring or unsettling depending on your perspective.

arm_steelweave_leggings.name: Steelweave Leggings
arm_steelweave_leggings.description: Tiny steel rings woven into heavy leather create a surface that distributes impact across the entire leg. The craftsmanship is obsessive. The protection is exceptional.

arm_scouts_halfgreaves.name: Scout's Halfgreaves
arm_scouts_halfgreaves.description: Greaves that protect only the shins, leaving the thigh free. Favoured by scouts who need to move fast and still protect the bones.

arm_cloth_wrappings.name: Cloth Wrappings
arm_cloth_wrappings.description: Strips of cloth wound tight around the head. No real protection. But they keep the blood out of your eyes.

arm_worn_sandals.name: Worn Sandals
arm_worn_sandals.description: Flat leather sandals held together by a few knots of cord. The soles are thin as paper. They'll last another week, maybe.

con_blessing_of_the_fallen_gods.name: Blessing of the Fallen Gods
con_blessing_of_the_fallen_gods.description: A vial containing something that should not exist in liquid form — concentrated divine essence from five dead deities, reclaimed from their burial sites. It heals everything. It also raises several theological questions.

con_crimson_healing_draught.name: Crimson Healing Draught
con_crimson_healing_draught.description: A deep red potion in a sealed crystal vial, prepared by an alchemist who no longer practises. The formula was never written down. Each vial is irreplaceable.

acc_chain_of_whispers.name: Chain of Whispers
acc_chain_of_whispers.description: A necklace of small iron discs, each engraved with a different face. When no one else is nearby, faint voices come from it. The advice is generally sound.

acc_band_of_the_fallen_king.name: Band of the Fallen King
acc_band_of_the_fallen_king.description: A wide gold band stained with old blood that will not wash out. It belonged to a king who died alone with his back to a wall. It carries the memory of a last stand.

arm_soulkeeper_visor.name: Soulkeeper Visor
arm_soulkeeper_visor.description: The visor is engraved with a thousand tiny faces — the souls it has absorbed from those slain before its wearer. They seem to shift.

wpn_twin_fang_daggers.name: Twin Fang Daggers
wpn_twin_fang_daggers.description: A mismatched pair of daggers looted from a fallen rogue. One is slightly longer. Both cut the same.

arm_voidweave_armour.name: Voidweave Armour
arm_voidweave_armour.description: Armour woven from threads harvested at the edge of a dimensional rift. Lighter than iron, harder than steel, and faintly cold to the touch.

arm_emberbrand_sabatons.name: Emberbrand Sabatons
arm_emberbrand_sabatons.description: Iron sabatons etched with flame runes along the instep. Walking on fire does not damage the wearer. Walking on ice leaves scorch marks. The paradox is unexplained.

wpn_iron_longsword.name: Iron Longsword
wpn_iron_longsword.description: Standard issue iron longsword. The balance is mediocre and the pommel is cracked — but the edge holds.

con_thin_mana_draught.name: Thin Mana Draught
con_thin_mana_draught.description: A pale blue liquid in a cracked vial — the bottom of a mage's supply barrel, diluted heavily. Weak magic, weak restoration. Better than nothing.

arm_blightwalker_legplates.name: Blightwalker Legplates
arm_blightwalker_legplates.description: Iron plates stained dark by blight exposure. Walking through cursed terrain with these equipped feels lighter — as though the blight recognises kin.

arm_eternitys_step.name: Eternity's Step
arm_eternitys_step.description: A pair of sabatons recovered from a tomb where time moved differently. The iron shows no age. The runes shift every time you look away. Wearing them, you feel unhurried — like you have all the time in the world.

arm_bonewoven_greaves.name: Bonewoven Greaves
arm_bonewoven_greaves.description: Iron greaves with small bones mortared into the outer surface as hex-wards. Heavy and unsettling to look at. Effective at keeping spirits at bay, allegedly.

con_wraithblood_extract.name: Wraithblood Extract
con_wraithblood_extract.description: A syrupy black-violet substance drawn from a captured wraith's residual essence. Mana is flooded into the body from an external source for several seconds. Those with weak constitutions should not use this.

arm_militia_chausses.name: Militia Chausses
arm_militia_chausses.description: Iron chausses issued to levy soldiers — not individual soldiers specifically, just levy soldiers generally. Mass-produced, imperfectly fitted, functional.

acc_iron_signet_ring.name: Iron Signet Ring
acc_iron_signet_ring.description: A ring bearing a seal that once meant something important. The house it represented is gone. The iron remains.

con_elixir_of_the_hollow_king.name: Elixir of the Hollow King
con_elixir_of_the_hollow_king.description: Said to have been brewed by a king who died refusing to stop fighting. The elixir restores all three vital reserves simultaneously. It tastes like grief and stubborn pride.

con_aetheric_mana_surge.name: Aetheric Mana Surge
con_aetheric_mana_surge.description: A pressurised vial that, when shattered on the palm, floods the system with raw aetheric energy. Mana restores completely. Side effect: you see colours that don't have names for about ten minutes.

acc_coldstone_pendant.name: Coldstone Pendant
acc_coldstone_pendant.description: A blue-white gemstone that never warms, even held in a closed fist. It draws heat from magical attacks and radiates it away before it reaches the skin.

con_smoked_cave_fish.name: Smoked Cave Fish
con_smoked_cave_fish.description: A whole fish cold-smoked in a cave over black coal. Dense, salty, and calorie-rich. Road food for those who know what's coming.

arm_dreadlords_visage.name: Dreadlord's Visage
arm_dreadlords_visage.description: An ancient war-mask that has absorbed the deaths of thousands of battlefields. Wearing it, you hear whispers. The whispers give good tactical advice.

arm_the_last_bulwark.name: The Last Bulwark
arm_the_last_bulwark.description: The breastplate worn by the final defender of a fallen kingdom. The dents and gouges in the iron number more than a hundred. It never failed him — the numbers finally did.

wpn_cracked_shortsword.name: Cracked Shortsword
wpn_cracked_shortsword.description: A shortsword that has seen too many fights. A hairline fracture runs along the spine — one bad swing from splitting in two.

acc_frayed_cord_necklace.name: Frayed Cord Necklace
acc_frayed_cord_necklace.description: A rough cord with a small piece of carved bone threaded onto it. Someone made it for luck. Whether it worked is unclear.

arm_spiked_iron_cap.name: Spiked Iron Cap
arm_spiked_iron_cap.description: A dome of iron with a single iron spike welded to the crown. Impractical but menacing. The spike once ended a fight before it started.

arm_plague_doctors_coat.name: Plague Doctor's Coat
arm_plague_doctors_coat.description: A full-length alchemist coat reinforced with plates of treated bone. Sealed against contagion. Sealed against much else besides.

arm_hunters_mask.name: Hunter's Mask
arm_hunters_mask.description: A carved wooden mask fitted to a leather backing. Painted in dark earth tones for stalking prey — or people.

arm_soulbound_boots.name: Soulbound Boots
arm_soulbound_boots.description: Boots that absorb a trace of the soul of anyone who dies within ten paces of the wearer. The accumulated weight of the dead makes your steps feel heavier. It also makes them more certain.

arm_brigands_visored_cap.name: Brigand's Visored Cap
arm_brigands_visored_cap.description: A light iron visor riveted to a leather cap. The visor flips up. Brigands favour them — protects the face without killing your peripheral vision.

wpn_blackthorn_sword.name: Blackthorn Sword
wpn_blackthorn_sword.description: Forged with iron laced with powdered blackthorn crystal. The metal has a faint dark sheen. Each strike carries a trace of corruption.

wpn_jagged_cleaver.name: Jagged Cleaver
wpn_jagged_cleaver.description: A heavy cleaver with a chipped, uneven edge that makes ragged wounds. Crude but effective — it doesn't need to be elegant.

con_ember_stamina_brew.name: Ember Stamina Brew
con_ember_stamina_brew.description: A hot, spiced drink brewed from ember-chilli and ironroot. Drunk warm, it burns all the way down and clears fatigue like smoke from a room.

con_voidblue_mana_elixir.name: Voidblue Mana Elixir
con_voidblue_mana_elixir.description: A swirling vial of dark blue liquid that smells of ozone and deep cold. Restores a large portion of mana in seconds. The rush lasts longer than expected.

wpn_soulbrand_greatsword.name: Soulbrand Greatsword
wpn_soulbrand_greatsword.description: A two-handed sword seared with sigils that bind the souls of the slain to the blade. It hums with trapped fury.

arm_bandits_kneeguards.name: Bandit's Kneeguards
arm_bandits_kneeguards.description: Thick leather kneepads strapped onto lighter legwear. Lets you kneel on rubble without flinching. Useful for ambushes.

acc_voidcore_pendant.name: Voidcore Pendant
acc_voidcore_pendant.description: A pendant containing a small perfectly black sphere that seems to absorb rather than reflect light. Magical effects from outside sources are partially absorbed by it before reaching you.

arm_crimson_warden_greaves.name: Crimson Warden Greaves
arm_crimson_warden_greaves.description: Lacquered red iron greaves worn by elite prison guards who never lost a prisoner. The red is original. A reminder to those who consider running.

con_dried_herbs_bundle.name: Dried Herbs Bundle
con_dried_herbs_bundle.description: A bundle of dried wild herbs tied with rough twine. Brewed into a weak tea or chewed directly, they ease pain and slow bleeding marginally.

acc_abyss_eye_pendant.name: Abyss Eye Pendant
acc_abyss_eye_pendant.description: A pendant containing a preserved eye from a creature that existed at the bottom of the ocean, in the dark, under pressure no living thing should survive. It still moves when no one is looking directly at it.

con_phoenix_ash_vial.name: Phoenix Ash Vial
con_phoenix_ash_vial.description: Ash harvested from the cooling nest of a phoenix, dissolved in purified water. The healing properties are not fully understood. The results are not subtle.

acc_inkstone_amulet.name: Inkstone Amulet
acc_inkstone_amulet.description: A flat black stone hung on a silver chain. The surface has faint carvings made with a mage's fingernail. Minor mana amplification — enough to notice.

arm_ghoststep_slippers.name: Ghoststep Slippers
arm_ghoststep_slippers.description: Thin-soled slippers woven from treated spiderweb silk reinforced with iron thread. Nearly silent on any surface. Light enough to run in. Surprisingly protective.

arm_ashen_warlords_helm.name: Ashen Warlord's Helm
arm_ashen_warlords_helm.description: The helm of a warlord who burned a city and then disappeared. It was found in the ashes, undamaged. The chin strap is still warm.

arm_warmongers_greathelm.name: Warmonger's Greathelm
arm_warmongers_greathelm.description: A full-face iron greathelm adorned with iron crests. Heavy and imposing. The narrow eye slit limits vision — but few enemies look you in the eye.

con_healers_distillate.name: Healer's Distillate
con_healers_distillate.description: A clear liquid prepared by a hedge-physician from twelve different medicinal herbs reduced down to a single drop of concentrated healing. The reduction fills a small vial. Each vial took three days to make.

arm_godgrave_tassets.name: Godgrave Tassets
arm_godgrave_tassets.description: Tassets pried from the lower armour of a dead deity. They still radiate a faint warmth, as though the god has not entirely finished dying.

con_restoration_compound.name: Restoration Compound
con_restoration_compound.description: An alchemical compound that simultaneously addresses blood loss, mana depletion, and fatigue. It was developed for battlefield medics and is no longer in legal production.

arm_tanned_leather_vest.name: Tanned Leather Vest
arm_tanned_leather_vest.description: Basic vest of tanned hide. Stiff and smells faintly of animal fat. Stops a glancing blow at best.

arm_marrow_legguards.name: Marrow Legguards
arm_marrow_legguards.description: Iron greaves packed with rendered bone marrow between the plates. The padding is grim but shockingly effective. Reduces impact trauma substantially.

acc_bronze_torc.name: Bronze Torc
acc_bronze_torc.description: A thick bronze neck torc bent into shape by someone who knew what they were doing. Carries a minor ward against the first cut of a fight.

arm_canvas_boots.name: Canvas Boots
arm_canvas_boots.description: Heavy canvas boots sealed with pine tar. Waterproof-ish. The toes are reinforced with scraps of iron. Functional.

arm_legguards_of_the_undying.name: Legguards of the Undying
arm_legguards_of_the_undying.description: Worn by a warrior who reportedly could not die. Eventually they stopped trying to kill them and just buried them alive. The legguards were found on the surface three years later.

acc_the_oath_ring.name: The Oath Ring
acc_the_oath_ring.description: A ring sworn on by the leaders of ten dead civilisations. The oaths are still binding in ways that defy explanation. The wearer inherits all of them.

acc_wardens_seal_ring.name: Warden's Seal Ring
acc_wardens_seal_ring.description: A heavy iron ring carrying the seal of a defunct prison authority. Wearing it makes those of weak will slightly reluctant to approach you.

arm_eternitys_aegis.name: Eternity's Aegis
arm_eternitys_aegis.description: A breastplate recovered from the ruins of a god's temple. The etchings on it move — slowly, over years. No one has lived long enough to read what they spell out.

acc_godbone_torc.name: Godbone Torc
acc_godbone_torc.description: A neck torc carved from a divine femur. The bone is ivory-white and almost weightless. The power within it is quiet and vast, like something sleeping very lightly.

arm_worn_wool_leggings.name: Worn Wool Leggings
arm_worn_wool_leggings.description: Felted wool leggings, damp-smelling and rough. They compress down to next to nothing in a pack. Nothing between you and a blade but a few layers of matted fibre.

wpn_venomstrike_blade.name: Venomstrike Blade
wpn_venomstrike_blade.description: A blade coated in a slow-acting poison extracted from swamp serpents. The cut stings. The venom lingers.

con_murky_water_flask.name: Murky Water Flask
con_murky_water_flask.description: A dented flask filled with water that has been boiled — mostly. It tastes of iron and sediment. It hydrates. That's all it does.

arm_tattered_hood.name: Tattered Hood
arm_tattered_hood.description: A hood of rough cloth, torn at the edges. It keeps the rain out — mostly. It won't stop a blade but it's better than nothing.
